_comment: Tap-to-explain texts for the Home market-risk card (design home/v006). One or two plain sentences each; the operator may edit them without a code change. {placeholders} are filled from config at render time (single_sector_pct from config/portfolio_risk_budget.yaml; trigger_book_pct and index_trigger_lagging_sectors from config/defense_recommendations.json inverse_etf). Advisory explanations only: no instruction, size or level.

stress.label: STRESS
stress.text: This group fell much more than it usually does and lagged SPY, over the last 5 sessions or in one day. 'Usually' is measured against the group's own past year, not a fixed percentage.

weak.label: WEAK
weak.text: Falling more than usual and lagging SPY, but not as far as STRESS.

resilient.label: RESILIENT
resilient.text: Beating SPY by more than usual for this group, or rising while SPY falls. It says where money is going now, not that it will keep going there.

holding.label: HOLDING
holding.text: Moving in line with the market: neither stressed nor clearly beating SPY.

not_measured.label: NOT MEAS.
not_measured.text: The engine does not have enough daily closes for this group yet, so it shows no state instead of guessing. The dollars you hold are still shown.

look_through.label: look-through
look_through.text: A fund is counted by what it holds, not by its name: a dividend ETF that is 9% technology puts 9% of its value in Technology. A stock is counted by its sector, or by its business segments once you approve them.

pct_book.label: % book
pct_book.text: Share of everything you own across all accounts, cash included.

stressed_pct.label: Stressed %
stressed_pct.text: How much of this position sits in groups marked STRESS or WEAK, after look-through. Themes overlap sectors, so they are never added on top.

usd_exposed.label: $ exposed
usd_exposed.text: Position value times its stressed share: the dollars that are in the groups being hit.

pc_oi.label: P/C OI
pc_oi.text: Put/call open interest: open put contracts divided by open call contracts on the index. Far above its usual level means traders are paying for protection.

carried.label: CARRIED
carried.text: The market is closed and this reading rests on Friday's data. It is shown so you can see it, but it does not page you.

shadow.label: SHADOW
shadow.text: The engine is evaluated but not allowed to send alerts yet. What you see is what it would have said.

stage1.label: Stage 1
stage1.text: An early sign the drop may be over: a higher low, then two green closes on normal volume, with its groups no longer making new lows. Early and more likely to fail than Stage 2.

stage2.label: Stage 2
stage2.text: Confirmation: a close back above the 10-day or 20-day average, or above the price you were stopped out at.

invalidates_below.label: Invalidates below
invalidates_below.text: The lowest close since you exited. A close under it cancels the early setup and the count starts again.

budget_breach.label: budget breach
budget_breach.text: An account is over one of your risk budgets, for example more than {single_sector_pct}% in one sector. It is a prompt to review, not an instruction.

vulnerability.label: vulnerability
vulnerability.text: A 0-100 score of how exposed the book is right now: concentration, stops close to price, positions with no stop and upcoming earnings. Higher means more exposed.

hedge_verdict.label: Hedge needed?
hedge_verdict.text: Read from the Defense desk. It considers an inverse-ETF hedge only when one weakening sector is at least {trigger_book_pct}% of your invested money, or {index_trigger_lagging_sectors} or more sectors are lagging.

rotate_rs.label: vs SPY
rotate_rs.text: The group's return minus SPY's over the same 1 or 5 sessions: +2% means it beat SPY by 2 points. It shows where money is moving; it is not a recommendation.

protect.label: Protect
protect.text: Your largest positions with something to review: a stop close to the price, no stop, or an account over a budget. Each one opens the existing review page; nothing is placed or changed from here.

tier_blue.label: BLUE
tier_blue.text: Calm: nothing in the book is close to a risk budget and few groups are stressed.

tier_yellow.label: YELLOW
tier_yellow.text: Watch: one budget or stress reading is near its limit, so the card is telling you early.

tier_orange.label: ORANGE
tier_orange.text: Elevated: at least one risk budget is over its limit, or several groups are stressed at once.

tier_red.label: RED
tier_red.text: High: multiple budgets are over their limits or a large share of the book sits in stressed groups.

score.label: Score /100
score.text: How exposed the book is right now, from 0 to 100: concentration, stops close to price and stressed groups. A smaller number is calmer.

categories_confirm.label: categories confirm
categories_confirm.text: How many of the nine scored categories independently point the same way. More confirming categories make the score more reliable.

repeat.label: repeat
repeat.text: This reading repeats the previous evaluation, so nothing material changed since the last check.

acknowledge.label: Acknowledge
acknowledge.text: Silences repeat notices for this episode until the situation changes. It does not change the tier or the score.

stressed_groups.label: stressed groups
stressed_groups.text: Groups marked STRESS or WEAK, counted after look-through. Themes overlap sectors and are never added together.

unprotected_budget.label: unprotected
unprotected_budget.text: Positions with no stop on file, as a share of the account. It compares against the unprotected budget you set.

stop_waiting.label: WAITING
stop_waiting.text: A stop exists but the broker has not confirmed it as resting yet. It is shown so you know what is intended.

pct_of_account.label: of this account
pct_of_account.text: This position's value divided by that account's total, cash included. Home shows a second percentage against the whole book.

inverse_funds.label: Inverse funds
inverse_funds.text: Funds that rise when their index falls. Their daily move is shown as context for the hedge decision, never as advice.

not_a_buy_list.label: not a buy list
not_a_buy_list.text: A ranking of groups by recent relative return. It describes what is working, not what to own.

rotate.label: Rotate
rotate.text: Which groups are leading or lagging over 1 and 5 sessions, and what you already hold in them. Descriptive only.

hedge.label: Hedge
hedge.text: The Defense desk's read on whether a hedge trigger is close, with the two conditions shown as progress.

wash_sale.label: Wash sale
wash_sale.text: Rebuying a sold security inside the wash-sale window defers the loss into the new position's basis. The card names the window.

pc_vol.label: P/C vol
pc_vol.text: Put/call volume: put contracts traded divided by call contracts on the index, and how that compares with its own median.

price_since_exit.label: price since exit
price_since_exit.text: The line starts at the price you exited, with the invalidation low marked. It shows the path since, not a forecast.

broker_resting.label: broker resting
broker_resting.text: The stop order is live at the broker. Pending activation means it is recorded here but the broker has not confirmed it.

status_chips.label: Status chips
status_chips.text: STRESS, WEAK, HOLDING and RESILIENT describe a group's behaviour versus the market over the last 5 sessions.

intentional.label: This is intentional
intentional.text: An operator decision recorded on this card. It explains why a reading looks the way it does and needs no action.

trim_review.label: trim review
trim_review.text: Positions large enough versus the rest of the book that a smaller size may be worth reviewing. A prompt, not an instruction.

heat.label: heat
heat.text: How much of the book is concentrated in a single group, shown after look-through. Higher heat means one theme drives the result.

rr.label: R:R
rr.text: Reward-to-risk: the distance to a sensible target divided by the distance to the invalidation level, measured at the current quote.

ma_10_20.label: 10-day / 20-day
ma_10_20.text: Simple moving averages of the closing price. A close above them is one of the Stage 2 confirmation routes.

rs_pts.label: RS pts
rs_pts.text: Relative-strength points: how far a group has beaten or lagged the market, in percentage points, over the stated window.

theme_overlap.label: theme overlap
theme_overlap.text: A holding can sit in a sector and in one or more themes. Overlapping groups are never summed into one exposure number.

budget_breaches.label: budget breaches
budget_breaches.text: Accounts over one of your risk budgets, for example too much in a single sector. Each row names the budget it broke.

score_today.label: Score today
score_today.text: The score's path across today's evaluations, oldest to newest, so you can see whether risk is building or easing.

source_clock.label: source and clock
source_clock.text: The card states each fact's source, and its time or age in ET when the payload carries a clock, as plain text. There is no show-source control, and a stale value is written out as 'stale' with its age rather than an amber section.
